title: SwarmX: Agentic Scheduling for Low-Latency Agentic Systems
authors: Yeqi Huang; Yanwei Ye; Guomin Chen; Wenhao Su; Bin Gong; Jialian Li; Zhan Lu; Yangshen Deng; Xuan Sun; Le Xu; Luo Mai
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Routing / Load balancing, Length prediction, Performance modeling, Capacity planning

problem_statement.en: Agentic AI applications compose multiple model calls and tool executions on GPU-CPU clusters, where both inference time and model-call structure depend on prompt semantics. Conventional routers and scalers (round-robin, power-of-two choices, average-based estimates) make poor decisions that persist under low-QPS, long-running agentic requests, amplifying tail latency and hurting utilization.
problem_statement.zh: Agentic AI 應用在 GPU-CPU 叢集上串接多次 model call 與 tool 執行，其 inference 時間與 model-call 結構皆取決於 prompt 語意。傳統 router 與 scaler（round-robin、power-of-two choices、平均值估計）的錯誤決策在低 QPS、長時間執行的 agentic 請求下會持續存在並放大尾延遲，資源利用率也隨之下降。

key_innovation.en: Agentic scheduling via scheduling-specific neural predictors: a small isomorphic semantic model (e.g. 35M parameters for a Qwen3-8B target) extracts prompt semantics, and a lightweight MLP combines them with device, runtime, and target-model features to predict inference-time and model-call distributions. Predictions stay distributional (quantile sketches) all the way to routers and scalers for tail-aware decisions, with OOD-triggered online MLP retraining and a scheduler-agent framework that plugs into existing infrastructure such as Ray and Kubernetes.
key_innovation.zh: 以 scheduling 專用神經預測器實現 agentic scheduling：小型 isomorphic semantic model（例如對 Qwen3-8B target 使用 35M 參數變體）擷取 prompt 語意，再由輕量 MLP 結合 device、runtime 與 target-model 特徵，預測 inference 時間與 model-call 分佈。預測以 quantile sketch 保留完整分佈並直接傳遞給 router 與 scaler 進行尾延遲感知決策，並配合 OOD 觸發的線上 MLP 重訓練，以及可掛載於 Ray 與 Kubernetes 等既有基礎設施的 scheduler-agent 框架。

baselines_compared: Murakkab, Ray Core, Power-of-Two Choices, Random, Production scheduler

key_improvements.en: Reduces tail latency by up to 61.5% versus state-of-the-art schedulers and sustains up to 2x the throughput of production schedulers under the same SLO; in production deployments P99 latency drops by 44-52%, and OOD-triggered retraining recovers from a severe workload shift within 100 s.
key_improvements.zh: 相較 state-of-the-art scheduler，尾延遲最多降低 61.5%；在相同 SLO 下可維持生產 scheduler 最高 2x 的吞吐量；生產部署中 P99 延遲降低 44-52%，且 OOD 觸發的重訓練可在 100 s 內從嚴重的 workload 漂移中恢復。

reported_accuracy: Output-length MAE 27.89 tokens (35M Qwen3 semantic model); latency-prediction MAPE Not Reported
models_validated: Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-32B, Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B, Qwen3-8B-VL, Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, Qwen3VL-8B, Qwen3-omni-30B
validation_workloads: DR Bench, OpenVid-1M, MCP-Atlas, SWE-bench Pro trace (DataClaw-PeterOMallet), Production traffic (11M records)

scope_assumptions.en: Predictors are trained from service traces and production logs, so accuracy depends on historical data per workload; most online drift is assumed correctable by retraining only the lightweight MLP (the semantic model is retrained only after target-model changes); prediction runs in ~30 ms on CPU or ~4 ms on GPU, small relative to seconds-to-minutes model execution; on predictor failure SwarmX falls back to the underlying scheduler policy.
scope_assumptions.zh: 預測器由 service trace 與生產 log 訓練，精度依賴各 workload 的歷史資料；假設多數線上漂移僅需重訓練輕量 MLP 即可修正（semantic model 僅在 target model 變更後重訓練）；預測在 CPU 上約 30 ms、GPU 上約 4 ms，相較秒級至分鐘級的模型執行時間佔比極小；預測器失效時回退至底層 scheduler 策略。
